name: final-large-v1

construction.source_access: SQLite mode=ro&immutable=1 plus query_only; no Library initialization
construction.root_received: aggregate counts, limitations and SHA commitments only
construction.private_material: Queries, anchors, real book identities and titles remain in ignored owner-read-only runtime files.

limitations: Agent-authored ground truth has no human rating or inter-rater validation.
Non-exhaustive anchors can miss other relevant passages; strict passage scoring can produce false negatives.
Queries were written after reading their target passages and may be easier than natural user requests.
Wrong-book negatives combine agent reasoning with absence checks for distinguishing terms; they do not prove corpus-wide absence or formal non-entailment.
Canonical exactness does not establish faithful transcription from a printed edition or present-day truth of historical assertions.
Scene cases include documentary situations as well as fictional scenes; sampling is not population-representative.
Procedural blinding within one agent team is not encryption or an independent human evaluation organization.
Zero retrieval runs is the status at sealing; later authorized final runs must be recorded separately without rewriting this commitment.
release_policy: No case inspection or retrieval run before an explicit recorded candidate freeze. Publish fixtures/provenance after the one-time final check; never tune against them while calling them held out.
